description: This file contains utility methods for an Android lifecycle sample project, specifically a Utils class that provides a method to print activity lifecycle states to TextView elements with a delay for visualization.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods, notably for printing the lifecycle state of activities within an Android app.

methods.name: printStatus
methods.description: Prints the list of lifecycle methods called and the status of all activities to provided TextViews, with a delay to account for overlapping lifecycle events.

methods.name: printStatus
methods.description: Prints the lifecycle method calls and activity statuses into specified TextViews with a delay to prevent overlap issues.
